how: One GET per page in headless Chromium from a scratch profile, signed out, no stealth plugins, 8 s wait; once from the live server (OVH, the service's own Playwright Chromium) and once from a home connection with the same Playwright build. Read-only.
finding: Where both columns are a Cloudflare challenge the block is the automated browser itself, not the server's address: a residential address would not change it.

crossmint_checkouts.how: Crossmint Agent Checkouts with a throwaway user (no card, no profile), one cheap item, delivery to 350 W 50th St, New York; stopped at the payment request, never answered, cancelled.

crossmint_checkouts.note: Three runs started in the same second all ended failed/reconciliation_required within 3 minutes, mid-browse, before any payment step; each run alone afterwards went through. Nothing was ordered: none had a card.
